svg.title: The life cycle of a finding
svg.desc: A finding is added through a write gate that reads every cited span, starts as a draft, is verified at its cited commit and reviewed by a different reviewer. When a newer commit is pinned it is re-anchored there: CURRENT if the cited bytes are still found once, STALE if they changed, UNVERIFIABLE if they are ambiguous or missing. A stale finding goes to the re-review worklist: supersede it with new spans, review it as is at the target, or retract it.
